disconnected: Spojenie s Amigent bolo prerušené. Skúšam znova…
send_tip: Kopírovať súbory z tohto PC do Amigy
mod_tip: Klik: len ďalšia klávesa. Dvojklik: zamknúť.
type_hint: Text ide do aktívneho okna, konce riadkov stlačia Return.
restart_text: Otvorené súbory sa najprv zapíšu na disk. Neuložená práca v programoch sa stratí.
about_text: Tvoja skutočná Amiga naživo na tomto počítači, s myšou a klávesnicou, aj cez pomalú sieť.
thanks_text: tbdye za amigactld (GPLv3), Volker Barthelmann za vbcc
pc_outdated: Amiga má novší Amigent ako tento počítač. Aktualizujte ho aj tu: pipx upgrade amigent
rel_mouse_tip: Zachytí myš a posiela jej pohyb, pre hry. Esc ju uvoľní.
get_tip: Kopírovať súbory z Amigy do tohto PC
clip_get_tip: Skopírovať schránku Amigy do tohto PC
clip_put_tip: Vložiť schránku tohto PC do schránky Amigy
clip_got: Schránka Amigy skopírovaná do tohto PC.
clip_put_done: Je v schránke Amigy. Vložte pravou Amiga+V.
fleet_run_placeholder: Príkaz AmigaDOS pre každú Amigu, napr. Version
pause_hint: Amiga prestane čítať svoju obrazovku, takže test alebo benchmark má procesor len pre seba. Myš, klávesy a súbory fungujú ďalej.
paused: Obraz na Amige pozastavený, zostáva {time}. Myš a klávesy fungujú ďalej.
update_running: Amigent sa aktualizuje. Okno sa zavrie a samo sa znova otvorí.
update_failed: Aktualizácia sa nepodarila. Podrobnosti sú v update.log v priečinku nastavení Amigentu.
machines_connect_to: Connect by saved name or address
machines_one_off: Connecting to an address does not add or change a saved Amiga.
machines_remove_hint: Remove this Amiga from the list? Its credentials and history will be kept.
machines_address_hint: This changes the saved address for this Amiga. An address already assigned to another Amiga cannot be used.
machines_rename_hint: Credentials, notes, and installation history stay with this Amiga.
machines_empty: No saved Amigas yet. Use amigent-setup to register one, or connect by address below.
machines_unavailable: Cannot reach the local machine manager. Reopen amigent-viewer.
reason_key_wanted: amigentd wants a key: run amigent-setup, or set AMIGENT_KEY.
reason_key_refused: amigentd refused the key; AMIGENT_KEY or the key in ~/.config/amigent/ must match S:amigent.key on the Amiga.
reason_unexpected_greeting: The Amiga sent an unexpected greeting.
reason_timeout: The Amiga did not answer in time.
reason_unreachable: The Amiga cannot be reached on the network.
reason_closed: The connection to the Amiga was closed.
reason_unresolved: The Amiga's address could not be resolved.
reason_plain_closed: amigentd takes only encrypted connections from other computers. Copy its certificate (tls-<name>.pem in ~/.config/amigent/ on the PC that set it up) to this one, or run amigent-setup again.
reason_no_tls: amigentd runs TLSONLY, but AmiSSL does not open there, so it turns every other computer away. Repair it at the Amiga: install AmiSSL again and run amigent-repair from the Amigent folder, or start amigentd SETUP there and run amigent-setup again.
reason_no_certificate: amigentd runs TLSONLY and AmiSSL works, but S:amigent-tls.pem does not load, so its encrypted port is closed and every other computer is turned away. Repair it at the Amiga: delete S:amigent-tls.pem and run amigent-repair from the Amigent folder, or start amigentd SETUP there and run amigent-setup again.
reason_tls_mismatch: The Amiga's TLS certificate does not match the saved one; run amigent-setup again.
reason_pin_ambiguous: Two saved Amigas share this address and their TLS certificates differ; fix the address in Your Amigas or run amigent-setup again.
reason_machine_changed: Machine changed; select it again in Your Amigas.
